messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

Excellent! Your phone now has strong 5G signal and data is enabled. Let's continue fixing the MMS prerequisites.

Next, let's address the APN settings. Since the MMSC URL is not set, this will prevent MMS from working. Please run: **reset_apn_settings** to restore the correct carrier settings.

After you've reset the APN settings, let me know and we'll proceed to the next step.

I have reset the APN settings. It says the changes will be applied after a reboot. Would you like me to restart the phone now to apply these settings? Please note, restarting won't delete any photos or data.

Please perform the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
